in_marathi.name: Charishmaa
in_marathi.long_meaning: Charishmaa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Charishmaa is derived from the Sanskrit word 'charish' meaning 'radiant' and 'maa' meaning 'mother'. This beautiful name symbolizes the inner radiance and nurturing spirit of a mother.
